This criteria allows to retrieve all Product records with a Product Relationship to a specified Product.

params.name: buyerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the a Buyer. MUST be specified in the request only when the requester represents more than one Buyer.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the Seller. MUST be specified in the request only when responding entity  represents more than one Seller.

params.name: offset
params.description: Requested index for start of item to be provided in response requested by client. Note that the index starts with "0".

params.name: limit
params.description: Requested number of items to be provided in response requested by client
